title: g0.2-observe-uprobe-migration
summary: No code changes required: probe_inject → observe(verb='create', condition.kind='uprobe') migration was already done in m7-02. The G0.2 cycle pins the negative contract of the observe tool surface with 2 typed-error tests in tests/observe_uprobe.rs (test_observe_with_invalid_verb_returns_typed_error, test_observe_uprobe_against_nonexistent_session_returns_typed_error). Wire smoke /tmp/g0.2-wire-smoke (3/3 GREEN against real chronos-mcp binary) confirms 3 contracts: schema (ObserveVerb snake_case), serde (tagged-enum ObserveScopeWire), JSON-RPC client (call_tool converts MCP errors to RpcError).
note: SHAs verified via git cat-file -e. Tag v0.7.112 peel 0be2ec2d intact. Sub-bug 'call_tool must return Ok' assumption in tests/observe_uprobe.rs was a latent G0.2 regression that surfaced as 0/2 failures; fixed retroactively in G0.4 cycle as part of the C5.2 sandbox-client work.
